# WO-608: Non-US past addresses cannot be entered
Status: queued (in-house, contract; decide scope first)
Vendor: claude
Agent: orchestrator
Owner: orchestrator (contract)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Kind: architecture
Tier: deep
Severity: LOW
Target release: 0.5
Source: owner real-data test, stage 1 (search only), qa-security 2026-11-11. Private results are kept outside the repo; this WO is PII-free by rule.

## Goal
`Address.state` must be a 2-letter USPS code (`models.py:250-262`) and the wizard enforces it (`wizard/draft.py:258-260`), so a person who lived abroad for a while (military families, the target market) cannot record that address at all. US brokers still list such addresses (APO/FPO and foreign ones), and some letters could cite them. The workaround of leaving it out loses a matching signal.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Decision recorded (owner/orchestrator): support (a) APO/FPO/DPO military addresses (state AA/AE/AP) only, or (b) `country` field with free-text region.
2. For (a): AA/AE/AP accepted as states with help text; for (b): `Address.country` default "US", non-US addresses are used for matching only, never in search URLs or forms.
3. Tests: such an address imports from the setup file, is stored encrypted, never reaches a search URL; US behaviour unchanged.
